situations.headline: Celsius Resources: Equinaire wins foreclosure auction for MHL's 40% MMCI stake amid contested OLSA default dispute

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Celsius Resources: Equinaire wins foreclosure auction for MHL's 40% MMCI stake amid contested OLSA default dispute (interest 7, risk 8)

thesis.text: Celsius Resources faces an existential asset-loss event as Equinaire has won a contested foreclosure auction over MHL's 40% interest in MMCI, a key project asset, via a credit bid with no competing bidders. The company disputes the underlying default triggers and is pursuing parallel legal and arbitration tracks, with a narrow 6-8 week procedural window (BIR tax clearance) before any share transfer can register. Outcome is binary and litigation-dependent: successful injunction/appeal preserves the MMCI stake, while failure crystallizes a material asset loss. High permanent capital loss risk warrants continued monitoring of court and arbitration developments.
